pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients and predominantly rounded vertices. The patches exhibit a consistent light-brown hue with minimal internal textural variation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined, forming a consistent web-like structure. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform throughout the mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the neck and shoulder ridge. The mane structure produces a soft serrated edge against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical skin fold or ridge is visible at the junction of the lower neck and the shoulder area.
